snippet.title: Creepshow | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Follow Danny and his friends as a bad day at the mall spirals into something much darker. Their search for the truth behind Danny’s father leads them to The Reader, a mysterious fortune-teller with a taste for treacherous tales.

Inspired by Shudder’s Creepshow, this playable horror anthology features pulp-inspired visuals, dark humor, comic-book environments, horror mini-games, and endings you won’t see coming.

OUT NOW ON STEAM!
